reason: A 3-day trial that bills on day 4 with payments final, and zero customer results, is not something I put my card into. I already pay a setter who works my inbox, and I have no proof this beats them.
objection: Three days is not enough to see a single booked call, and then I'm locked into a charge I can't get back. With no published results and 7 seats taken, I'd be the guinea pig.
would_change_my_mind: A trial long enough to see replies (7 to 14 days) or a refund window after the first charge, plus a few real results from people selling what I sell.
